name: ChangeResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The cloud service identifier. Fixed as APIG. You generally do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 云服务标识，固定为 APIG，一般无需传入
parameters.name: service

parameters.help_en: The resource type. The value is case-sensitive and must exactly match one of the valid values
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型，区分大小写，必须与枚举值完全一致
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource to be moved. The value must match the specified ResourceType
parameters.help_zh: 需要转组的资源 ID，需与 ResourceType 匹配
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination resource group. You can view resource group IDs in the Resource Management console
parameters.help_zh: 目标资源组 ID，可在资源管理控制台查看
parameters.name: resource_group_id
